description: Query intents re-authored 2026-08-09 under docs/audit/rag-eval-query-style.md, after maintainer review of the v1 draft rejected its style on two counts: it wrote full sentences for users who are typing on a controller, and it assumed players describe rather than name. Both are fixed here. Written BEFORE the cards they will match (R1), so no row was authored from a card. `withheld_card_terms` lists card *phrasing* a query must not contain -- proper nouns never belong there, because a player reading a name off the screen is not cheating. Renamed from `ban_verbatim`, which read as though naming a boss were disallowed. `ask_mode` is gone as a query-level field: after D17 retrieval no longer depends on it. `expect_section` / `expect_topic` stay empty until cards exist and the maintainer signs off; this is not a scoring fixture until then. Two new titles, Portal 2 and Half-Life 2, are present here with no seed cards behind them yet -- their rows will score as misses, which is the honest reading and not a bug. Several power-user rows across every title target content the corpus does not have (versus, tier lists, map callouts, speedrun routing); they stay in so the gap shows as a miss rather than being hidden by only asking what we can already answer. Spoiler note: rows tagged in `note` as spoiler-relevant are deliberate. A player who types 'adam smasher fight' or 'wheatley fight' has already reached that point, so the question is not itself a spoiler risk -- but a card answering it must not volunteer what comes after. These rows exist so that behaviour is measurable.
